exercises.title: No banks, no tiles
exercises.body: The main path gives you word banks to lean on. This one does not: read the Shavian, work out what it says, and write it. If a word will not come, sound it out letter by letter — that is what the alphabet is for, and it is the whole reason it can be learned in an afternoon.
